# KAWA Omakase

> KAWA Omakase is a reservation-only Japanese omakase restaurant in NYC's East Village offering a 14-course seasonal chef-led sushi tasting menu for $88 per guest. Located at 37 E 1st St, New York, NY 10003. Reservations on Resy.

## Quick Facts

- Name: KAWA Omakase
- Cuisine: Japanese omakase, sushi, Edomae sushi tasting menu
- Address: 37 E 1st St, New York, NY 10003 (East Village, Manhattan)
- Phone: (347) 619-3346
- Email: kawaomakase37@gmail.com
- Price: $88 per guest (14-course tasting menu)
- Reservations: Required, via Resy
- Chef: Chef Tony (formerly Catch NYC, Sushi Dojo, Sushi on Jones, Akimori, Bonito 47)
- Hours: Tue–Thu and Sun 5:00 PM–10:00 PM; Fri–Sat 5:00 PM–11:00 PM; Closed Monday
- Rating: 4.9 / 5 (180+ reviews)
- Neighborhoods served: East Village, Lower East Side, NoHo, Nolita, SoHo, Bowery, NYU, Greenwich Village, Union Square, Chinatown
- Best for: affordable omakase NYC, omakase under $100, date night, birthdays, first-time omakase, downtown Manhattan visitors
